title: Quiz YAML
description: Schema for an LLM-graded, open-ended quiz definition. Kept in sync by hand with the Zod schema in lib/quiz-schema.ts, which is the source of truth for validation.

id.description: Short machine-readable quiz id, e.g. countries-basics. Used as the per-quiz identity.

name.description: Optional human-readable quiz title (used as a label).

title.description: Optional greeting shown to students on the welcome screen instead of the default message.

description.description: Optional description shown to students below the welcome greeting (Markdown).

anonymous.description: Quizzes are anonymous by default: answers are recorded for aggregate stats but not linked to a student. Set to false to attribute each attempt to the signed-in student.

shuffle.description: Present questions in a random order per attempt. Set to false to keep the authored order.

fragment_files.description: Optional fragment libraries this quiz pulls shared prompt fragments from.

fragments.description: Optional fragments selected from fragment_files. Assembled in priority order and prepended to BOTH the grader prompt and the discussion chat's system prompt.

questions.description: The quiz questions. Each is open-ended and graded by the LLM via its evaluation prompt.

model.description: The model that grades answers and drives the per-question discussion chat.

provider.description: The LLM provider serving the model. For Azure Foundry, model is the deployment name.

imageInput.description: Default for all questions: students may attach photos (up to 3, 5 MB each) to their answers. The model must be vision-capable. A per-question imageInput overrides it.

instructions.description: Optional guidance appended to the per-question follow-up discussion chat's system prompt.

id.description: Stable question id, unique within the quiz (the per-question stats key).

title.description: Optional short label for the stats table and progress display.

question.description: The Markdown shown to the student.

evaluation.description: The grading prompt. SERVER-ONLY: never sent to the browser, so it may embed the expected answer and the grading rubric.

imageInput.description: Overrides the quiz-level llm.imageInput for this question only (photo answers on/off).

hosted.description: When true, src is an app-hosted image NAME resolved server-side; otherwise src is an absolute URL or a path relative to the quiz's own URL.

src.description: The hosted image name (when hosted) or the image URL / relative path.

alt.description: Accessible description shown if the image cannot be loaded.

credit.description: Optional attribution ("Content Credentials") shown small below the image.

url.description: HTTP(S) URL or relative path to the fragment library.

id.description: Fragment id inside the referenced library.

variables.description: Literal values passed into the fragment template.

bind.description: Accepted for compatibility but ignored by the current assembler.

required.description: Marker for important fragments. Accepted but not currently enforced.
